name: Participant
doc: One chat member and when they joined.

fields.name: user_id
fields.doc: Stable internal identifier for the member. -> ChatByUser.user_id; projected into Chat.participants. This is the system's own UUID, distinct from the externally supplied principal below.

fields.name: authenticator
fields.doc: Identity provider / SSO mechanism that authenticated this member, e.g. 'openid', 'oidc', 'saml', 'google-oauth2', 'okta-saml'. Names a third-party single sign-on scheme rather than a local password; qualifies how 'principal' should be interpreted and which IdP to trust it against.

fields.name: principal
fields.doc: The subject/username as asserted by the authenticator, e.g. 'alice.nguyen', 'bmartinez@example.com', or an IdP subject claim. A human-meaningful login identifier, NOT a UUID; do not use in place of user_id for keys or joins.

fields.name: joined_at
fields.doc: When this member joined the chat (UTC epoch millis). -> ChatByUser.joined_at
